verdict: Group means are consistent with the overall mean, but the reported group SDs (1.69, 1.62) imply an overall SD of ~1.65 and t = 1.93 (p = 0.056), not the reported SD 1.78 and t = 1.790 (p = 0.0765). The reported t and overall SD are mutually consistent with a pooled SD of ~1.76, so the group SDs printed in Section 4.4 / Figure 4 are probably mis-transcribed. Resolve by recomputing from the raw results file.
